title: Emergent Abilities in Large Language Models: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2503.05788v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are leading a new technological revolution as one of the most promising research streams toward artificial general intelligence. The scaling of these models, accomplished by increasing the number of parameters and the magnitude of the training datasets, has been linked to various so-called emergent abilities that were previously unobserved. These emergent abilities, ranging from advanced reasoning and in-context learning to coding and problem-solving, have sparked an intense scientific debate: Are they truly emergent, or do they simply depend on external factors, such as training dynamics, the type of problems, or the chosen metric? What underlying mechanism causes them? Despite their transformative potential, emergent abilities remain poorly understood, leading to misconceptions about their definition, nature, predictability, and implications. translated_title: 大语言模型中的涌现能力：一项综述
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）正引领一场新的技术革命，是迈向人工通用智能最有前景的研究方向之一。这些模型的扩展，通过增加参数数量和训练数据集的规模实现，与各种此前未观察到的所谓“涌现能力”相关联。这些涌现能力，从高级推理、上下文学习到编码和问题解决，引发了激烈的科学争论：它们是否真正涌现，还是仅仅依赖于外部因素，如训练动态、问题类型或所选指标？其背后的潜在机制是什么？尽管具有变革性的潜力，涌现能力仍未被充分理解，导致对其定义、性质、可预测性和影响的误解。在这项工作中，我们通过共同（此句原文不完整，此处按原文截断处理）来阐明涌现能力。
tldr: 本文综述了大语言模型中涌现能力的定义、争议、潜在机制及其影响因素，旨在澄清误解并推动对其本质的系统理解。
en_tdlr: This survey clarifies the definition, debates, underlying mechanisms, and influencing factors of emergent abilities in large language models, aiming to resolve misconceptions and advance systematic understanding.
